checkNote: README says 'paste your API key (get one at platform.deepseek.com)' and the default is 'apiKey: ""'. llm.js:63-64 refuses to run when there is no key (`if (!apiKey) {`), so the LLM lookup cannot be used without one. The README says any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works by changing the base URL, but neither the pack nor the code mentions Ollama, localhost or local models, and a key is still required. So local use is not settled.
